119047.overview: Don't Get Hit By Blue Balls! Keep your Red Square away from the Blue Balls on your way to the Green Zone or you'll DIE! And trust us; you'll die. A lot.

119048.overview: Oh, you think you're so smart. Well, Harder 2 is 50 levels of brain-crushing pain. How long can you withstand the awesome power of angry blue circles?

201246.overview:
Simple mouse control aim and click to putt the ball into the hole. Practice on any hole by selecting from the score screen. Unlock "Wonder Collectables Mode" after the first full game complete to maximize your points!

Wonderputt is Damp Gnat’s award winning iOS and online Flash adventure-golf game, launched 15th August 2011 on Kongregate and 13th September 2012 on iPad.

Initially estimated at a 2 month production period, ended up taking over 5 months over a year between contract work. It was made using 3DStudioMax (for small objects) but mainly Adobe Photoshop, Flash and cheap note pads. The game uses Adverputt’s core code but with 18 holes, each with their own unique animated features.  The theme encompasses all manner of scientific illustration from geographic encyclopedias to instruction manuals….. but with cows, toads, ski slopes, torpedos and a sprinkle of alien abduction for good measure.

419661.overview:
Wordle is a word construction puzzle title based on the concept used in the American game show Lingo from the 1980s and presented as an online, daily word guessing game. Every day players can guess a word with five letters. There are only six tries to get it right. The player inputs the letters and then feedback is shown through colours. Green means the letter is part of the word and in the right position, yellow means the letter is part of the word, but not in the right position and grey means the letter is not part of the word at all. Grey letters are also shown on the virtual keyboard at the bottom of the screen, which helps to find words that contain letters that have not been tried yet. All entries need to be valid words at all times.

After completing the puzzle the performance and steps can be shared spoiler free on social media or through other forms of digital communication. Options include two themes (dark and light), a color blind mode and a hard mode. In the hard mode you need to abide by the hints you have uncovered (green / yellow / gray). Enabling it means you cannot enter a random word, you need to take the hints into account.

451415.overview:
Spec Ops: War on Terrorism is a first person shooter flash game developed by Thorsten and released on December 27, 2001.

In Spec Ops: War on Terrorism, the player takes control of a soldier who is fighting terrorists and must complete four unique missions. In these missions, the player is armed with three weapons; an M4A1 is the player’s primary weapon, which has 30 bullets per magazine and can be switched to by pressing the 1 key. The player’s secondary weapon is an M9 9mm pistol which holds 15 rounds per clip and can be switched to in a pinch. The third weapon in the game that the player has in their arsenal is an M40A1 sniper rifle which can only be used in the second mission, where the player will have to take wind into account in order to use it effectively.

In the first mission of the game, the player attacks a camp full of enemy soldiers and must eliminate them all as they run out of their tents to attack. In the second level, the player has entered a cave and must ambush a group of enemies who are initially facing away from them, some of whom will take cover once fired upon. The third mission allows the player to use the sniper rifle from a vantage point, where they must snipe all enemy soldiers without raising the alarm. In the final mission, the player reaches Bin Laden and can rough him up a bit before he is handed over for capture.

451571.overview: Use the skills of the four special agents (kla, lucas, ryoh and steve) to complete the mission and save the day! Lots of animations and special bonuses that can be unlocked with high scores!

451573.overview:
Warlords, also know as Warlords: Call to Arms, is a strategy flash game in which the player’s main objective is to get as many of their soldiers across the battlefield and into the enemy’s side of the map without them being killed. They must also prevent enemy soldiers from reaching their side of the map by sending out soldiers to stop them. In each battle, soldiers can be trained and spawned on eight lines that go across the map in a horizontal fashion. Each time one of the player’s soldiers successfully reaches enemy territory, the territory bar at the top of the screen will fill up more with the player’s races colour and when it is fully their colour, the player will win the battle.

The main game mode in Warlords is the single player campaign, in which the player must pick a race that they want to play as and lead to conquer the land, one region at a time. They will earn money from killing enemy soldiers and winning battle which they can spend on upgrades and new unit types.

The Demon Race cannot be obtained at the start of the game. You must beat the campaign with any race to obtain the demon race.

451574.overview: "Warzone Tower Defense Extended" expands upon the original game adding new tower upgrades and other unlock-able enhancements.

451575.overview:
Which-Way Adventure is an adventure Flash game.

At each point in the adventure choice game, the player is presented with a series of options – the outcome of the adventure will depend on which options. Some choices can have consequences.

451586.overview:
Weapon, sometimes stylized as Weapon., is a shooter Flash game developed by simonhason and published on Newgrounds and Kongregate on December 18, 2009.

In this shooter defense game, the player has to protect their team's helicopter for as they as you can. They can buy weapons and upgrades to neutralize the enemy more effectively.

451589.overview:
Whack Your Boss is a simple beat the boss game with a dark and sense of humor. Hidden in the simple drawing of a cubicle office space, you can find 24 different to whack your boss. Click on any one of those to trigger a different animated sequence. All you really have to do is find the right object to click on. Once you do that, a short animation will unfold taking place in the same cubicle. Each of them focused on you while beating, fighting and killing your boss. How will your frustrated employee respond to the supervisor's condescending attitude and frustrating ticks?

All animations you will find here are build around a very simple idea. What would happen if you were to unleash your pent-up anger on your boss? The answer comes in the form a crude, yet surprisingly violent video of one guy straight up killing his boss. Each boss battle is a crazy, and bloody depiction of revenge and over-the-top carnage.

451591.overview:
Warfare 1917 is an war strategy flash game developed by ConArtists and released on September 19, 2008.

In Warfare 1917, the player controls either the British or German army depending on the campaign or custom battle that they are playing. The main objective of the game is to defeat the opposing army by either completely draining their morale meter or filling the progress bar at the top of the screen which is done by advancing allied troops all the way into enemy territory. In the main game mode campaign, the player will unlock new unit types as they advance through the missions as well as acquire XP that goes towards points that can be spent on unit upgrades.

Like with many 2D flash strategy games, once in battle, the player can choose which units to train from a bar along the bottom of the screen and each unit has a unique cool down timer with the more powerful units generally taking longer. Commonly found on the battlefields in the game are trenches, which can give the player or their enemy a great advantage by allowing them to send their units into them for cover, making them much more resistant to bullet damage. Each trench can house up to three units at a given time.

The player also has access to support weapons such as artillery strikes, which can deal devastating amounts of damage to enemy units and are great from removing enemy soldiers from trenches.

451595.overview: A fighting game based on the famous stickman martial arts animations.

451621.overview:
The teleporting runestones William has arranged in the forest area around his cabin have been disabled. William suspects area gnomes as the culprits, and asks his animal pal Sly the fox to see what he can do about re-activating them. And the player is off in the woods, a red streak amongst the green, running and jumping up tree boughs and ravine cliffsides, digging through concealed underground tunnel systems (where the gnomes have hidden their precious and eminently collectible mushrooms!) in search of the inert runestones and the sparkling randomly-spawning fairyflies needed five at a time in order to restore them.

Sly isn't the only one who likes fairyflies, however; flat areas are inhabited by Darklings, hungry blob-like enemies who don't injure Sly but feed on any fairyflies he may happen to have around his person. These Darklings can be vaporized by being touched by Sly following his glowing-white triumph immediately following the restoration of a runestone.

Though the game's primary goal can be completed in short order, following the restoration of the runestones and overcoming a jarring boss battle in William's storage cave, it has many challenges for completists, including finding all of the mushrooms. Achieving this will necessitate not only acquiring an aerial power-up, but locating and tripping gnomish switches to restore glowing magical bridges leading to flying islands, where the final few mushrooms can be located. Additionally, many of them are hidden "in plain sight" - inside locked treasure chests strewn intermittently across the landscape, which require the use of foraged keys to unlock.

451622.overview:
Winning! The Charlie Sheen Game is a racing Flash game.

In this game, the player plays as Charlie Sheen and has to race to be the first.

451623.overview:
WpnFire is a game with no plot, no storyline, and no real objectives other than to use explosives, automatic weapons, and whatever else it takes to kill anything that gets in your way.

Remember that adventure mode is a relatively small part of the whole game; there are several other variants of gameplay to test your survival, defense, and evasive skill.

451625.overview: Ladies and gentlemen, I'd like to welcome you to the all-rabbit world one-jump championships! The player here controls the movements of a snow bunny with the mouse, scampering around a snowy winter landscape. Above this lagomorph hang bells (suspended by skyhooks, no doubt), and guiding the rabbit carefully to come into contact with as many of them as possible after liftoff is the goal of the game here, as a bell encounter gives the rabbit a little altitude boost -- ideally up into the next bell. On this grading scale, rabbits are only given one single leap to prove how high they can go, and it is only by carefully plotting a focused itinerary through these bells (and birds, which give a x2 score multiplier) that a player can take their rabbit up into the stratosphere and into the high score tables.

451626.overview: WOne is a 2D physics platformer. The player controls a wheel where they would have to collect all the barrels then find the exit. Players can control the spin of the wheel using the the cursor keys.

451632.overview:
Windosill is a puzzle game that involves a cute toy car. Players need to guide it through different, single screen rooms and discover the solution to open up the next room. This is always done by locating a cube that unlocks the door. In order to do so, items in the environment can be dragged and clicked. By interpreting the results, the actions can be linked to find a solution. The toy car itself can also be picked up and moved around, and interact with the objects in a physics-based environment.

Many objects and themes in the game also appear in earlier Vectorpark games, with an often absurdist style. Although most rooms seem simple at first, they require a lot of trial and error to discover the solution. The first levels can be played free of charge in a browser. The full game can be downloaded for a fee or is unlocked with a code.

The later-released iPad version adds a sketchbook gallery, a level selection, and a translucent mode that allows the player to see how levels have been put together with 3d polygons.

451634.overview: In this game, players control Winnie the Pooh in baseball games against his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood. Pooh is the batter, and during each round he is pitted against a different pitcher. Each round has a different amount of pitches thrown in total, and a target number of home runs that must be hit. All of the opponents have different throwing styles and gimmicks that the player needs to contend with. In order to have a better chance against the more skilled opponents, players are able to use their accumulated points to increase the strength, speed, and accuracy of their swings.

451687.overview: Windhawk is a flying action game. In this game, the player pilots a gyro copter armed to the brim with highly advanced military equipment. They can deploy and use the robotic cannon to target and destroy enemy air force invading air space.

451742.overview: We Become What We Behold is a game about sensationalist media and the social effects it has. The player is presented with an open area full of people, and is instructed to take photographs of anything interesting that happens. These events are then broadcast on a screen, which characters will react to in increasingly significant ways.
